title: [review] message.rs:212: Dao D-flag normalization break
description: When parsing D=0 (DODAGID elided per RFC 6550 section 6.4.2), the code stores Some([0u8; 16]) instead of None. However, write_to checks is_some() to set D=1 (line 238). This means parsing a wire D=0 DAO and re-encoding it produces D=1 output with explicit zeros. While documented as intentional for LICHEN, this non-idempotent behavior could cause interop issues with RFC 6550-compliant nodes expecting D=0 preservation.
